subject: SOC2 / SIG continuity evidence request & witness plan
messages:
From: Leah Park <leah.park@commercio.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: commercio-security@commercio.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2/SIG continuity evidence + witness

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our SOC2 readiness and SIG assessment we're collecting continuity and recovery artifacts from critical vendors. We need the following completed by May 6 to hit our internal audit window: 

- A mapping of your product tiers/services to RTO and RPO commitments (preferably a CSV with environment, service component, recovery step, RTO, RPO).
- Representative restore logs for a full service recovery (redact any customer identifiers) — looking for timestamps and elapsed durations so we can validate your recovery timelines.
- A short (30–45 min) witness/demo slot where an engineer can walk our auditor through a tabletop run of the recovery steps and answer questions.

Can Redwood do a live witness on the week of May 3–7? Our preference is Tue/Thu afternoons (EDT). Also please confirm what artifacts you can provide as attachments versus what we should expect during the live session.

If you already have a SOC2 supplement or CAIQ entries that cross-reference these items, that would be helpful too.

Appreciate it — tight deadline.

Best,
Leah Park
Sr. Security PM, Commercio Inc.
leah.park@commercio.com

[Attachment requested: example CSV template, auditor contact: commercio-security@commercio.com]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@commercio.com>
Cc: commercio-security@commercio.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG continuity evidence + witness

Hi Leah —

Thanks — we can absolutely support this. I've attached an initial RTO/RPO mapping and a compact witness plan for the tabletop session. Quick notes: 

- Attachment: rto_rpo_mapping_2026-04-20.csv — contains service-level rows (API, inference runtime, KV cache, control plane) with stated RTO/RPO and typical recovery path.
- Attachment: restore_sample_logs_2025-11-02.txt — sanitized restore log excerpt showing elapsed times for a multi-region failover we ran last year.
- Attachment: witness_runbook_excerpt.pdf — 6-page excerpt from our recovery runbook tuned for audit walkthroughs.

We can host a 30–45 min witness/dry-run with one of our on-call SREs plus a security engineer. Proposed slots (EDT): May 4 14:00–14:45, May 5 16:00–16:45. Please confirm preferred slot and whether your auditor needs any pre-sent materials (we can redact and pre-send logs).

I'll loop in Hannah (SRE) and Marissa (Security) to prepare the artifacts and handle any redaction. If you need an NDAsigned copy first let me know — we have a standard non-prod evidence-sharing addendum.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0172

[Attachments: rto_rpo_mapping_2026-04-20.csv (text/csv), restore_sample_logs_2025-11-02.txt (text/plain), witness_runbook_excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC2/SIG continuity evidence + witness

Folks — forwarding Commercio's request. Key deliverables and owners below. We need redacted artifacts ready to send by EOD Apr 28 and the runbook + witness prep by EOD May 1.

Action items:
- Hannah: produce a sanitized restore log showing timestamps for snapshot apply, KV warm, service mesh bring-up. Please include elapsed durations and an environment label (e.g., staging/replica-2025-11-02). If possible include the failover orchestration timeline.
- Marissa: prepare a one-page summary mapping our documented RTO/RPO to the CSV rows and confirm what we list in our SOC2 supplement. Verify any customer data that must be redacted and sign off on sharing.
- Sean: I'll coordinate delivery and confirm the witness slot with Leah.

Notes: we should avoid sending KMS key identifiers and full ARNs; redaction guidelines attached (internal). Keep logs to <5MB or share via the secure Drive link (see Jira PRO-1234).

Thanks —
Sean

[Internal only — do not forward outside Redwood without Marissa sign-off]

From: Leah Park <leah.park@commercio.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: commercio-security@commercio.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG continuity evidence + witness

Hi Sean —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. May 4 14:00–14:45 EDT works for us; we'll have one auditor and one security PM on the call. Please pre-send the CSV mapping and the runbook excerpt (PDF) by Apr 28 so our auditor can review ahead of the session. For the restore logs, redacted logs via Google Drive link are fine (we'll accept the secure link).

Also can your SRE be prepared to speak to the following during the witness: 
- how we measure RTO during a multi-region failover
- steps for cache warming and time-to-first-inference after restore
- rollback conditions and time metrics

If you can confirm the deliverables and the Drive link by EOD Apr 22 we'll lock this into the auditor schedule.

Thanks —
Leah

[Commercio auditor contact: commercio-security@commercio.com]
